definitions.covered: Text represents the central requested action/physical response; not a correctness label and not a guarantee every outcome/detail is covered.
definitions.partial: Some aligned action or mechanism is present, but a central outcome, event order, actor/tool or continuation is missing or displaced.
definitions.absent_or_replaced: Requested central process is absent or replaced by a different activity/setup.

records.caption: A long jumper demonstrates a flawed technique, resulting in a short distance and an unbalanced landing.
relations: Athlete’s arms extended outward, indicating imbalance during flight phase.
Body positioned asymmetrically, suggesting poor center of mass control.
Legs bent unevenly, implying compromised landing stability.
Airflow around limbs suggests motion, but no visible fluid dynamics altering trajectory.
records.note: 描述失衡、重心控制和落地稳定性，覆盖主要失误；未解释短距离。

records.caption: A thin piece of wood is bent into a bow shape, exhibiting its flexibility.
relations: Men grasp wood ends; their hands apply force to bend it into bow shape.
Wood flexes under tension, maintaining continuous curve as men hold positions.
If force persists, wood may deform further or return to original shape.
Sweat may appear on men’s skin as they exert physical effort.
records.note: 包含施力弯曲和持续弧形；末句出汗是附加细节。

records.caption: A gymnast performs a back handspring, landing cleanly on their feet on a padded floor.
relations: Gymnast’s hands press down on mat, initiating upward momentum for the back handspring.
Body arches backward as legs extend, preparing for inverted flight phase.
Core muscles stabilize torso, maintaining alignment during aerial rotation.
Feet remain together and pointed, ready to absorb impact upon landing.
records.note: 包含撑地、后翻、姿态稳定和落地准备。

records.caption: A plastic ruler is bent until it cracks, displaying a visible stress fracture that propagates.
relations: Man and child hold ruler horizontally, hands gripping ends firmly.
Ruler visibly cracks mid-span, fracture line propagating under applied stress.
Crack path appears jagged, indicating material failure under bending load.
Fluids or continuous processes not visibly involved in this static fracture event.
records.note: 包含弯曲应力与裂纹传播，但把将发生的破裂写成已可见/静态事件。

records.caption: A close-up shot of a paddle making contact with the ping pong ball, showing the impact.
relations: Paddle edge near net, ball resting on table—contact imminent, motion pending.
Ball stationary, paddle poised—impact will alter ball’s trajectory and spin.
Net’s mesh and table lines remain fixed—impact may cause slight vibration.
Air around ball and paddle will compress and disperse with contact.
records.note: 包含球拍接触将改变球运动；空气压缩并非请求的主要响应。

records.caption: A large, wet canvas is twisted to remove excess paint, leaving drips down the side.
relations: Canvas stands upright, supported by metal frame, showing no visible wetness or drips.
Two individuals sit near canvas, one holding equipment, neither interacting with canvas surface.
Studio lighting equipment remains stationary, casting no motion or fluid effects on canvas.
Floor shows no wet marks or fluid trails, indicating canvas is dry or not actively being manipulated.
records.note: 四句集中于画布未湿、未操作和静态环境，没有扭转挤漆与滴落。

records.caption: Multiple ping pong balls are shown, illustrating different stages of a rally.
relations: White balls rest on blue surface, shadows cast beneath each one.
Balls are stationary, no motion or contact with each other.
Surface appears dry, no visible fluids or continuous processes.
If balls were struck, they might roll or bounce, altering positions.
records.note: 仅描述静止球及被击打时可能运动；没有回合阶段组织，原请求本身也较含混。

records.caption: A person bounces to a specific rhythm on a trampoline, their body movement clearly timed to a beat.
relations: Person’s arms extend outward as they rise, preparing for rhythmic bounce.
Legs bend at knees during descent, absorbing impact before rebound.
Trampoline surface deforms under weight, returning to flat as person ascends.
Hair moves with motion, trailing behind as body rotates mid-air.
records.note: 包含有节奏弹跳、下落缓冲与蹦床回弹；末句头发旋转为附加内容。

records.caption: A construction worker uses a suction cup to lift a heavy glass panel with a small picture adhered to it; the picture remains affixed.
relations: Worker holds suction cup against glass; adhesive bond persists despite applied force.
Picture remains affixed to glass as suction cup lifts panel; no detachment observed.
Worker’s posture shifts slightly; suction cup maintains contact with glass surface.
No visible fluid movement; suction process relies on air displacement, not liquid flow.
records.note: 包含吸盘举升玻璃和画片保持附着。

records.caption: A person mops up a puddle of water on a concrete floor, the water disappearing as the mop passes.
relations: Mop bristles contact water, initiating displacement and spreading across floor surface.
Water flows outward from mop path, thinning as it moves away from center.
Floor reflects light where water pools, diminishing as absorption or evaporation begins.
Mop handle remains upright, suggesting continued motion through liquid zone.
records.note: 写成拖把使水向外扩散、变薄及蒸发；未明确拖过后持续清除水迹。

records.caption: A person on a unicycle stops abruptly, putting a foot down to maintain balance before continuing.
relations: Rider’s foot is elevated, balancing on single pedal, body leaning forward slightly.
Unicycle’s wheels remain in contact with asphalt, maintaining forward momentum.
Sock pattern visible, suggesting motion continues despite abrupt stop attempt.
If rider places foot down, weight transfer will shift, altering balance point.
records.note: 有脚落地的条件性重心转移，遗漏停稳后继续；用袜子图案推断运动缺乏支持。

records.caption: A player hits the ball off the side of the mallet, resulting in an unexpected trajectory.
relations: Hand grips racket handle, poised to strike yellow ball on green court surface.
Racket strings face downward, positioned near ball, ready for contact.
Ball rests stationary beside racket, awaiting player’s motion to initiate action.
If struck, ball may rebound unpredictably off racket’s edge or frame.
records.note: 保留边缘击球改变方向的机制，但把mallet换成带拍弦的racket。

records.caption: A person uses a pair of pliers to open a stubborn metal bottle, bending the cap slightly in the process.
relations: Pliers grip metal cap, applying force to deform it slightly.
Hand holds pliers steady, maintaining pressure on cap’s edge.
Cap begins to bend under applied mechanical stress.
Bottle remains stationary, fluids inside unchanged during manipulation.
records.note: 包含钳夹瓶盖使其弯曲，但没有瓶盖打开这一结果。

records.caption: Multiple water balloons are tossed upwards, simultaneously bursting in the air in a small arc.
relations: Water balloons ascend due to initial force, visibly separating as they rise.
Balloons burst upon reaching peak, releasing fluid droplets downward.
Droplets scatter in arcs, influenced by gravity and air resistance.
Splash forms at impact point, indicating fluid continuity and momentum transfer.
records.note: 包含上抛、爆裂和液滴分散；到达顶点便爆裂的时点并非请求提供的条件。

records.caption: A rower pulls an oar from the water, the blade dripping water back into the lake. .
relations: Oar blade submerged in water causes droplets to form and fall back into the lake.
Rower’s motion lifts oar blade, initiating water dripping from its edge.
Water continues dripping from blade as it clears the water surface.
Rower’s posture shifts slightly as oar is pulled from water.
records.note: 明确包含抬桨离水与持续滴水；首句水下形成滴落表述不够准确。

records.caption: A scientist uses a probe to nudge a small, delicate insect on a leaf, causing it to twitch minimally.
relations: Blue-gloved hand holds probe near insect on leaf surface.
Probe tip contacts insect’s body, causing slight twitch.
Insect remains on leaf, possibly shifting position slightly.
Fluids may transfer between probe and insect during contact.
records.note: 包含探针接触引起轻微抽动；额外加入探针和昆虫间液体转移。

records.caption: A unicycle wheel rolls over a small curb; the rider adjusts their position to keep upright.
relations: Rider’s foot presses pedal as wheel contacts curb, shifting body weight forward.
Wheel’s spokes rotate continuously as it rolls over the curb’s edge.
Rider’s knee bends to maintain balance as center of mass adjusts.
Grass beside curb remains static while wheel disturbs its edge.
records.note: 包含轮碰路沿、身体重心调整和维持平衡。

records.caption: A bulldozer pulls a heavy load attached with a chain, moving it across the ground.
relations: Chain links connect load to bulldozer, transferring force as machine moves.
Soil load shifts slightly under chain tension as bulldozer advances.
Ground surface deforms beneath tires, creating displaced soil trails.
Engine fluids circulate continuously to support mechanical operation.
records.note: 包含链条传力、拖动载荷和地面响应；发动机内部液体循环属附加内容。

records.caption: Javelin with a damaged tip is thrown; it wobbles in flight and lands off-target.
relations: Javelin’s damaged tip causes imbalance, altering its flight path unpredictably.
Air resistance acts unevenly, increasing wobble during flight.
Gravity pulls javelin downward, affecting its trajectory and landing point.
Wind may shift javelin’s course, changing where it lands relative to target.
records.note: 包含损坏尖端造成不平衡、飞行摆动和落点变化；另加入可选风影响。

records.caption: A time-lapse showing the process of someone tying a bow tie, quickly showing the steps in sequence.
relations: Hands grasp bow tie ends; fingers adjust fabric against shirt collar.
Bow tie rests centered on collar; knot remains untied and loose.
Fingers pull loops apart; fabric stretches slightly under tension.
Hands position bow tie symmetrically; collar stays aligned beneath.
records.note: 描述手部调整、松散结和对称摆放，未覆盖按顺序系成蝴蝶结。

records.caption: A skateboarder rolls along a smooth concrete path, maintaining a steady pace.
relations: Feet planted on board—skateboarder’s stance enables controlled motion on concrete.
Wheels roll smoothly—friction between tires and pavement sustains forward momentum.
Legs slightly bent—body posture adjusts for balance as speed increases.
Concrete surface remains unchanged—skateboarder’s movement disturbs only minor dust or debris.
records.note: 包含滑板滚行与平衡，但速度增加和请求保持匀速不一致。

records.caption: A luger's sled impacts a small snowbank at the edge of the track, causing a slight spray of snow.
relations: Luger’s sled glides on snow, tracks visible behind, snow spraying forward from sled’s path.
Luger’s body leans forward, hands clasped, maintaining balance as sled moves.
Snowbank edge ahead may cause sled to lift slightly, altering trajectory.
Continuous snow spray from sled’s runners may increase as speed or terrain changes.
records.note: 有滑行喷雪及雪堆影响的条件句，未明确实际撞雪堆后短暂喷雪。

records.caption: A surfer falls off their board, colliding briefly with another surfer, before swimming away.
relations: Surfer in neon vest rides wave ahead of second surfer, both on water surface.
White foam sprays from board edges as surfers carve through breaking wave.
Surfers maintain close proximity, bodies angled toward wave’s face.
Water continuously flows around surfers, carrying spray and momentum.
records.note: 描述两人相近滑浪及水花，没有落板、短暂相撞、游离的过程。

records.caption: A speeding car crashes into a brick wall, crumpling the front end and stopping abruptly.
relations: Car’s front end impacts wall, causing visible deformation and brick displacement.
Dirt and debris spray outward from point of collision due to sudden force.
Vehicle’s rear remains intact, suggesting impact concentrated at front.
Tire contact with pavement persists, indicating braking or skidding prior to impact.
records.note: 包含车头撞墙、形变与碎片；由轮胎接地推断此前刹车/侧滑缺少依据。

records.caption: A large, orange plastic egg is rolled up a plastic slide, then rolls down, ending at the bottom.
relations: Orange egg rests on surface beneath transparent curved slide.
Slide’s curvature suggests potential for rolling motion.
Egg’s smooth surface may interact with slide’s texture during motion.
Fluid-like slide implies possible frictional or aerodynamic effects during roll.
records.note: 仅有可能滚动，没有先上后下并停底部的顺序，fluid-like slide含混。

records.caption: Two people stretch a bungee cord, extending it to its maximum length.
relations: Bungee cord stretches taut between two anchor points above ocean surface.
Black cylindrical weight hangs suspended, swaying slightly with cord tension.
Orange harnesses attached to cord indicate human operators managing tension.
Ocean water remains calm, undisturbed by cord’s motion or weight.
records.note: 将两人拉伸绳的过程换成海上悬挂配重/安全带/张力状态。

records.caption: Hands shape a lump of clay-like bread dough into a smooth, round boule on a wooden table.
relations: Hands press dough downward, flattening its top surface slightly.
Flour dusts table and board, clinging to hands and dough edges.
Dough resists compression, maintaining its rounded form under pressure.
Hands move in tandem, applying even force to shape the dough’s exterior.
records.note: 包含手部对面团施力和塑形；是否完成光滑圆形仍需实际视频。

records.caption: A person skillfully tosses several coins in the air, catching them one by one.
relations: Hand holds silver coin, poised to release it into air.
Two gold coins hover mid-air, suspended by unseen force.
Red pegs remain stationary below, awaiting coin landings.
Second hand prepares to catch falling coins, fingers slightly curled.
records.note: 包含抛出和接住准备；将空中硬币称为受不可见力悬停是不可靠解释。

records.caption: A player hits a forehand drive, the ball spinning rapidly as it crosses the net.
relations: Ball rests on court surface, untouched by player or racquet.
Net divides court, remains stationary as ball approaches.
Player’s racquet not visible, so no immediate motion or contact.
Air remains still, no visible fluid motion or disturbance yet.
records.note: 只说球静止、无人击打、拍不可见和空气静止，未覆盖正手击球、旋转与过网。

records.caption: Someone throws a snowball into the air, it breaks apart during flight.
relations: Snowball in air shows initial trajectory from thrower’s hand.
Snowball’s fragmentation begins as it ascends, altering its shape.
Snow particles drift apart under air resistance during flight.
Snowball’s mass decreases as fragments disperse through atmosphere.
records.note: 包含上抛后碎裂、颗粒分散与形状变化。

records.caption: A tightly folded parachute is unfolded, revealing its vibrant colors and intricate design.
relations: Parachute lies flat on ground, surrounded by equipment and textured surfaces.
Small yellow object stands upright near parachute’s edge.
Green box-like device rests nearby, with yellow tether attached.
Parachute’s fabric remains static, no motion or unfolding visible.
records.note: 只描述静态伞布和周边设备，未覆盖展开过程。

records.caption: A player uses a quick set to spike the ball, driving it downward at a steep angle.
relations: Player holds ball near net, poised to strike with racquet.
Racquet face angled downward, ready to drive ball steeply.
Legs bent low, body weight forward for explosive downward motion.
Sweat may bead on skin as muscles prepare for rapid force application.
records.note: 包含向下击球的方向，但把快速托球扣杀换成球拍击球。

records.caption: A player jumps high to block a spike, their hands impacting the ball forcefully, sending it back across the net.
relations: Player in blue holds ball above net, poised to strike.
Opponent in red crouches near net, ready to react.
Ball is airborne, approaching net for potential block.
Net remains taut, dividing court as players prepare.
records.note: 有网前准备和可能拦网，没有跳起、手触球和挡回对面这一实际响应。

records.caption: A large, clear balloon is inflated with air, showing the internal pressure causing the balloon to stretch.
relations: Air inside balloon exerts pressure, stretching the elastic material outward visibly.
Internal pressure remains balanced with external atmospheric pressure as balloon floats.
Continuous air molecules collide with balloon walls, maintaining its inflated shape.
If air escapes, balloon will shrink; if sealed, shape persists under current pressure.
records.note: 提到内部气压使材料伸展，但后续主要维持已有膨胀形态或漏气缩小，未描述持续充气。

records.caption: A woodcutter with a long handled axe chops down a thick tree in a forest.
relations: Axe blade contacts tree bark, initiating wood fracture and splintering.
Woodcutter’s grip shifts as force transfers through handle to axe head.
Tree trunk leans slightly as internal fibers begin to separate under impact.
Moss-covered ground absorbs falling debris and scattered wood fragments.
records.note: 包含斧头接触、木纤维分离及树干倾斜。

records.caption: A slow-motion view of the jump showing leg extension and body position.
relations: Person’s arms extended backward, pulling torso forward as legs stretch outward mid-air.
Gravity pulls downward while muscles maintain leg separation against momentum.
Air flows past body, resisting motion as limbs remain extended.
Center of mass shifts slightly forward as jump apex is reached.
records.note: 包含跳跃时腿伸展、身体姿态和重心变化。

records.caption: A competitor approaches the runway, accelerates, jumps, and lands with their legs spread wide.
relations: Aircraft hovers above runway, engines producing thrust to maintain altitude.
Runway surface remains stationary, textured grid visible beneath aircraft’s path.
Air flows around aircraft, creating lift as it hovers above the ground.
Aircraft descends toward runway, preparing for landing with legs spread wide.
records.note: 将运动员助跑起跳落地解释为飞机悬停和降落。

records.caption: A paint roller, dipped in green paint, is used to cover a section of a metal fence, creating a uniform green coat.
relations: Roller’s textured surface contacts metal fence, transferring green paint via physical adhesion.
Paint flows continuously from roller to fence as it rolls, covering surface uniformly.
Fence’s metal grid remains structurally intact while paint layer builds on its surface.
If roller continues rolling, more fence area will become coated with green paint.
records.note: 包含滚筒接触转移油漆、连续覆盖与涂层增加。

records.caption: A wedge is driven into a log using a sledgehammer, splitting the log cleanly apart.
relations: Axe blade embedded in log’s end, splitting wood fibers apart.
Person’s boot near axe, stabilizing stance during impact.
Log’s cut surface exposed, revealing fresh wood grain.
Grass beneath log remains undisturbed, no visible fluid movement.
records.note: 把锤击楔子劈木改成斧头已经嵌入木头；缺少锤到楔的施力链。

records.caption: Poi are swung against a soft surface, making a thudding sound (NOTE: This prompt includes sound, but it's included to illustrate the effect of the action, not to describe it in detail.  The focus is still on the visible impact).
relations: Gray object’s shadow lengthens as it impacts the surface, altering its visible position slightly.
Yellow object’s surface texture may compress momentarily upon contact with the soft surface.
If green objects strike the surface, their shadows will darken and elongate slightly from the impact.
No fluid movement occurs; all objects remain dry and stationary after impact unless displaced.
records.note: 主要谈影子变化和可选压缩，摆动后接触软表面的主过程表达较弱。

selected_first_image_checks.scope: assistant directly viewed the original single first-frame canvas

annotation_author: Assistant qualitative reading of all40 stored positive reasoning texts; not human gold-standard annotation or an independently validated automatic metric.
outcome_scope: Historical R1 scores were already known; request-anchor candidate scores were not available or used to create these labels. Keep all40 in the main comparison; subgroup analysis is descriptive.
interpretation: Input-text coverage and initial-image alignment are separate from learned Q/C collapse and execution errors. Shared input defects do not explain away paired PC losses or prove the physical module effective. No source cache, benchmark caption, first image or completed score is changed.
